text: ロケットだん　やっつけたの　たった　ひとり　だって…　すごいな

structure.jp: ロケットだん　やっつけたの
structure.en: the one who beat Team Rocket

structure.jp: たった　ひとり　だって…
structure.en: was just one person, I hear...

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.span: ロケットだん　やっつけたの
patterns.explanation: の after a verb stands in for 'the one' who did it. ロケットだん　やっつけたの = 'the one who beat Team Rocket'.

patterns.name: 〜って (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: って at the end says this is something the speaker heard from others. ひとり　だって = 'I hear it was one person'.
